goal_intent: book a table for two, then change your mind and say it is four

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m calling to book a table for this Saturday—my friends and I are planning a little dinner to catch up. Is there any availability around 7pm?
It’ll just be two of us to start off—my friend Neve Ashworth and myself. The others haven’t confirmed yet, but it’s always nice to have a quiet dinner.

Oh, actually, I just heard back from our friends—looks like we’ll need a table for four instead! Sorry for the last-minute change. No special requests for the kitchen, just a regular booking for four please.

Perfect, thanks so much! Neve Ashworth is the correct name for the booking—just wanted to make sure it’s under her. Everything else sounds great, and I appreciate your help with the change. Have a lovely day! 

[END OF CALL]
